question_text: Aapko kitna loan amount chahiye, aur is loan ka upyog aap kis kaam ke liye karenge?
Aapka poora naam kya hai, aur kya yahi naam aapke PAN/Aadhaar card par likha hai?
Aapka mukhya kaam ya vyavsay kya hai, aur aap kis specific product ya service ka vyapar karte hain?
Aapka abhi ka rehaishi pata kya hai, aur aap yahan kitne saal se reh rahe hain?
Aapka ghar khud ka apna hai ya kiraye par hai?
Aapke parivar mein aapke saath kaun kaun rehte hain (patni, bachhe, mata-pita, anya)?
Kya ghar mein aapke alawa koi aur bhi kamata hai? Agar haan, toh kis kaam se?
Kya aapke bachhe school ya college ja rahe hain? Unki mahine ki padhai ka kharcha lagbhag kitna hai?
Aapke ghar ka mahine ka kharcha (rashan, bijli, kiraya aadi) lagbhag kitna hota hai?
Kya aapka abhi koi aur loan (personal, gold, vehicle, business) chal raha hai? Kiske paas hai aur mahine ki EMI kitni hai?
Kya aapne pehle koi loan liya tha jo ab band ho chuka hai? Kya unki kist time par chuki thi?
Kya aap kisi aise vyakti ka naam aur number de sakte hain jo aapko acche se janta ho (rishtedaar na ho, padosi ya vyapari ho)?
Aap aasaani se har mahine kitni EMI bhar sakte hain?
Aap naukri (salaried) karte hain ya apna khud ka kaam/business (self-employed) karte hain?
